payload.rationale: Selected from 4 validation-only trials. Direct capacity upgrade of the round-1 winner (hidden 48→64, depth 3→4). The 97.64% result left ~2.4% error; a wider, deeper residual stack should capture finer-grained pathology patterns. Dropout raised 0.2→0.25 and label_smoothing 0.05→0.1 to regularize the extra parameters. All other hyperparameters (adamw, cosine, lr=1e-3, wd=0.01, bs=128, standardize, 3 augmentations, class_weighting) are held constant to isolate the capacity effect.
